named_question: Does the mood IID field represent an input binding or the icon selected by native grid column3?

static_byte_pins.purpose: Actual caller's dialog constructor installs the CIconDlg vtables, not an input-selection dialog.
Accepted dialog selection UUID is resolved through the same manager; record+0x70 or lookup-miss0 is stored in selected mood+0xac, then grid rebuilt.
Zero initialization at+0xa8 includes numeric IID+0xac.

reused_contract.fact: Reuse common integer type5 omitted-reader default0. IID uses the same binder type/flags and constructor default, but is a different member and meaning.

source_contract.correction: The input-binding hypothesis is disconfirmed. Actual grid column3 opens CIconDlg, initializes it from stored IID through integer lookup, obtains a selected icon UUID, resolves that UUID back to a numeric ID and stores IID. No input/hardware assignment is established by this path.
source_contract.catalog_boundary: The integer IID is not a native GUID catalog identity. Existing Energy ico/GUID catalog selection cannot be applied directly to it; manager registration/mapping is a separate dependency.
source_contract.zero_boundary: Constructor/reader model default0 is established. Accepted lookup-miss0 is an observed source branch, not proof of a user-reachable accepted clear choice or a claim that every rendered default icon is absent.

CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting inspect-mood-options FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME
CLI_policy.icon_id: Report IID stored/effective/default0 using a conservative signed32 decimal interpretation. Preserve omitted raw null; unsupported explicit data stays unresolved with diagnostics rather than becoming0.
CLI_policy.resolution: Always report unresolved_catalog_mapping; do not infer builtin/project SVG, hardware/input role, rendered image, default-icon appearance or validity of a numeric ID.
CLI_policy.formats: JSON adds icon_id and icon_resolution; table/seven-column CSV add IID with explicit stored presence and icon_reference_unresolved projection.
CLI_policy.preservation: Read-only. No IID, input, CID, SID, image catalog, Qn, flags, counts, references, HCL or unknown data changed.

unimplemented_dependency.scope: User-reachable accepted empty/clear selection and builtin/project UUID-to-numeric-IID registration/copyback
unimplemented_dependency.decision: No clear-mood-input command and no raw integer icon assignment/clear. Publish corrected inspection/contract, park mutation at this bound and continue independent source operations.
